branch: renderAsk (85-cards.js): a single-select question whose options carry `preview` gets an .ask-prev monospace box under its option list, following hover > checked > option 0 (an option without one shows 'No preview for this option'), and its pick no longer auto-advances to the next tab so the preview stays readable; Submit appends askSummaryHtml() (50-blocks.js) — one .ask-sum-row per question — through resolveAsk's new third argument; replayAsk (55-replay.js) draws the same box for the picked option and the same summary when not denied; multiSelect questions never get a box (the tool's own rule).
provenance: The `preview` field is REAL: plugin/src/test/resources/fixtures/replay-sample.jsonl line 5 is a CLI 2.1.220 AskUserQuestion tool_use whose option 0 carries exactly this preview string (copied verbatim, description shortened); the second question and the multiSelect question are synthetic additions shaped like it (needed so auto-advance has a next tab to jump to). `permission_request` and `__transcript` are OUR frames (ChatPanel's shapes, fixtures 11/83/08) — self-consistency for the page half. The 2.1.296 tool schema says previews render 'as markdown in a monospace box' and are 'only supported for single-select questions' (checklist 1.31). NEGATIVE CONTROL: RUN 2026-10-10 against the sandbox still serving the pre-change build (fixture written first, sandbox launched before any edit): 7 passed / 15 failed / 0 aborts — every DISCRIMINATING assert failed on 'absent' / 0 / '' (no .ask-prev box, auto-advance hid panel 0, no .ask-sum rows, live and replay alike); the passes are the GUARDs (both questions drew, the card resolved, the result line, the tabs kept, the multiSelect card — that guard was first written as 2 inputs and read 3 on the pre-change build too (two options + the Other row), corrected to 3 before the fixed-build run).
